statement: 1. A word-hyperbolic group acting properly and cocompactly on a CAT(0) cube complex is virtually compact special. 2. A hyperbolic group with a finite graph-of-groups decomposition whose edge groups are quasiconvex in the ambient group and whose vertex groups are hyperbolic VCS is VCS. The same applies to a finite hierarchy of such decompositions. 3. A compact special cube complex admits a cubical local isometry to a Salvetti complex. Its defining graph can be taken finite.
